note_title: 判断级数收敛性与部分和渐近展开
summary_en: This note studies the convergence and asymptotic behavior of the series \(\sum_{n\ge 2}\frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n}+(-1)^n}\). It first proves divergence via termwise asymptotic expansion, then asks for a sharper asymptotic formula for the partial sums with an \(o(1)\) error by separating even and odd terms.

problems.statement_en: Determine the convergence of the series \(\sum_{n\geq 2}\frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n}+(-1)^n}\).

Obtain an asymptotic expansion of \(S_N\) with error \(o(1)\). Equivalently, compute \(\lim_{N\to \infty}\left(\sum_{2\leq n\leq N} f(n)+\log N\right)\), where \(f(n)=\frac{(-1)^n}{\sqrt{n}+(-1)^n}\).
problems.statement_zh: 得到$S_N$的精度为$o(1)$的渐近展开。或者换言之，我们需要求$$\lim_{N\to \infty }\sum_{2\leq n\leq N}f(n)+\log(N)$$的结果。
key_techniques: splitting into even and odd terms

key_techniques_discussed: splitting an alternating sum into even and odd parts
connections_mentioned: alternating series related to the eta function
